scope.summary: Add alert tagging with many-to-many persistence, tag assignment/removal endpoints, composable tag filtering on list, and tag projection in alert response.
scope_anchors: POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags with case-insensitive dedupe and per-alert max/tag-length validation
DELETE /api/alerts/{id}/tags/{tag} returning 404 when alert or assignment does not exist
GET /api/alerts optional tag filter composable with existing filters

validation: dotnet ef migrations add AddAlertTagging --project AlertService.Data.SQL --startup-project AlertService.API
dotnet ef database update --project AlertService.Data.SQL --startup-project AlertService.API

deterministic_prepass.smallest_concrete_scope: Alerts API + service + SQL repository + EF model/migration path
likely_risks: Integration tests already reference AddTagsRequest while DTO type is absent in current source
Tag normalization/matching semantics not fully specified

unresolved_questions: Should GET /api/alerts?tag=... match any assigned tag exactly (case-insensitive) or support partial matches?
Should tags be persisted in canonical form (first-seen casing, lowercased, or trimmed-only)?
Should DELETE /api/alerts/{id}/tags/{tag} treat URL-decoded whitespace/special characters as valid after trim?
